# Learned instinct: ansible-validate-certs-never-false (confidence 1)

`validate_certs: false` is never acceptable for Ansible tasks targeting PCI-scope systems. This is a CRITICAL finding — it exposes the connection to MITM attacks and violates PCI DSS Req 4.2.1 (strong cryptography in transit). If a cert is untrusted, fix the trust chain — don't disable validation.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 4.2.1; ansible-lint rule [no-free-form]
